name: campaign_06_circuit_board
description: Four renal tributaries converge into two separate vascular fronts. Curved septa divide the post-fork approach before each front drains toward an unseen organ.

editor.notes: Two independent visible fronts share one hidden downstream organ. Every inlet has an authored complete route; timed waves pin the matching marker and route. Septa shape actual horde movement. Full marker discs and organ footprint remain outside 16:9 and 21:9 starting views.
